sources.snippet: Krea 2 - an image generation model from Krea AI. API Docs • Hugging Face (RAW) • Hugging Face (TURBO) • Technical Blog This is the official repository for the open version of Krea 2, an image model trained from scratch focused on creative and stylistic exploration. The repository contains inference code and instructions to run the model.

sources.title: Krea2 Raw/Base & Turbo (BF16/FP8/NVFP4/INT8) High Quality Image Gen
sources.snippet: (b) Krea 2 Turbo - It is an 8-step distilled checkpoint built for fast, high-quality text-to image generation. The model is distilled from a fully post trained Reinforcement Learning (RL) checkpoint, allowing it to produce better-quality images compared to Raw while maintaining much faster generation.
